description: VICINITY provides a core ontology for describing the core information to be used in VICINITY ecosystem. This core ontology, which relies in more general modules or cross-domains ontologies (e.g., time, space, web things, etc.), might be extended for more specific domains and applications (e.g., health, buildings, transport, etc.)
